what: Engram feature parity: chunked git sync and obsidian export
why: All Engram-inspired features implemented and tested. Fixed NULL last_seen_at scan bug in scanMemories, GetMemory, and ReviewMemories.
learned: last_seen_at column is NULL for records created before the migration — must use sql.NullString for scanning. Chunked sync writes one file per memory ID to .sv-memory/chunks/ to avoid Git merge conflicts. Obsidian export writes .md files with YAML frontmatter and [[wikilinks]].
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
impact: All Engram competitive features ported. Build clean, all tests pass.
next_steps: End session, optionally update spec.md and AGENTS.md to reflect new tool count (16 MCP tools) and chunked sync format
